sinopsis.es: Yonfan transforma fragmentos de sus quince películas en una meditación brillante e inclasificable sobre el cine, la memoria, la belleza, el deseo y su propia obra, con Maggie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat, Sylvia Chang, Shu Qi, Daniel Wu y muchos, muchos más.
sinopsis.en: Yonfan transforms excerpts from his 15 films into a brilliant, genre-defying meditation on cinema, memory, beauty, desire, and his own singular body of work, featuring Maggie Cheung, Chow Yun-fat, Sylvia Chang, Shu Qi, Daniel Wu, and many, many more.
